releases.name: AbyssME 0.7.0 Beta 10
releases.body:
# AbyssME 0.7.0 Beta 10

Beta 10 adds **global physical-controller profiles** and improves Mophun sound and game speed.

Open **Settings → Physical controller profiles** to edit the global mapping or create reusable profiles for buttons and both sticks. Assign them to games from the manager or each game's Controls page. Graphics, touch layouts and physical mappings stay independent. Existing per-game overrides take priority; shared changes apply the next time the game opens. Profiles are included in library backups.

Mophun sound is now enabled for every game. Short BEEP effects and `vBeep` are supported, and PCM follows pause and emulation speed. A common phone-model execution budget reduces excessive speed in CPU-dependent games such as the supplied Boulder Dash and Lemtris versions.

- **ARM64:** `AbyssME-0.7.0-beta.10.apk` — Java ME, Mophun and experimental Symbian/N-Gage.
- **ARMv7:** `AbyssME-0.7.0-beta.10-armv7.apk` — Java ME and Mophun, without Symbian.

Android 10+ is required. Both update the existing app in place. Back up important saves before updating or switching architecture. Source bundles and SHA-256 checksums are included.

releases.name: AbyssME 0.7.0 Beta 9
releases.body:
Beta 9 adds **independent right-stick mapping** for physical controllers.

Open **Controls → Controller mapping → Sticks** to assign the right stick’s directions and diagonals to phone keys, soft keys or Fire. **Identify** detects right-stick movement; pressing R3 remains a separate input. Bindings are saved per game, and existing profiles keep their settings with the new directions unbound.

The shared input path supports Java ME, Mophun and Symbian/N-Gage. This maps stick directions to digital keys; it does not add proportional analog camera support to games.

- **ARM64:** `AbyssME-0.7.0-beta.9.apk` — Java ME, Mophun and experimental Symbian/N-Gage.
- **ARMv7:** `AbyssME-0.7.0-beta.9-armv7.apk` — Java ME and Mophun, without Symbian.

Android 10+ is required. Both update the existing app in place.

Tested with automated input and a virtual joystick on Retroid; physical dual-stick hardware testing remains pending. Source bundles and SHA-256 checksums are included.

releases.name: AbyssME 0.7.0 Beta 8
releases.body:
Beta 8 fixes Lara's black/striped appearance and loading-screen text showing through her model in **Tomb Raider: Underworld 3D**. The cause was incorrect transparency when transferring M3G rendering to the Java ME screen.

Startup errors now show the original game exception instead of only `InvocationTargetException`.

- **ARM64:** `AbyssME-0.7.0-beta.8.apk` — Java ME, Mophun and the combined Symbian runtime.
- **ARMv7:** `AbyssME-0.7.0-beta.8-armv7.apk` — Java ME and Mophun, without Symbian.

Both require Android 10+ and update the existing app without uninstalling.

The reported **Crash Titans 1.3.7 Sony S700i JAR** was also checked. Its code and packed resources are inconsistent; the same reader fails on ordinary Java outside AbyssME. This release does not make that particular JAR playable.

Checks: 427 JVM tests per build, focused Retroid renderer tests, signed APK update and first-room checks. This is not complete-game acceptance. Source bundles and SHA-256 checksums are included.

releases.name: AbyssME 0.7.0 Beta 7
releases.body:
# AbyssME 0.7.0 Beta 7

## Separate graphics and control profiles

- **Settings → Graphics profiles** and **Settings → Control profiles** now have
  independent global defaults, named profiles and assignments. Each game can
  select one graphics profile and one control profile. Changing or resetting
  one category leaves the other intact; extra Gamepad buttons remain available.
- Graphics profiles include supported scaling, smoothing, built-in xBRZ/CRT,
  FSR/sharpness, interpolation, LCD filters and capture settings. Java GPU and
  Mophun support GPU effects; Symbian uses its supported host display options.
  Integer scaling falls back to Fit on Symbian. Java-only geometry options are
  identified in the editor's support information.
- Beta 6 combined profiles split automatically: LCD inheritance and exceptions
  move to graphics, while touch settings remain in controls. Other existing
  graphics remain explicit overrides. Reset the relevant category's overrides
  when you want existing games to inherit a shared setup.
- Both catalogs, including unassigned profiles, travel through library backups.
  Phone backups retain portable game definitions. Picture Keep/Undo preserves

releases.name: AbyssME 0.7.0 Beta 6
releases.body:
# AbyssME 0.7.0 Beta 6

## Shared profiles and extra touch buttons

- Set global touch/LCD defaults and create named profiles from **Settings →
  Profiles / Global defaults**. Link individual games or assign a profile to
  several prepared games. Edit a shared profile once; linked games use it on
  their next launch.
- Keep per-game exceptions, inspect which profile supplies each setting, and
  reset individual overrides. Existing game settings stay unchanged on upgrade;
  explicitly reset their touch/LCD overrides to adopt shared settings.
- Add up to twelve independent Gamepad buttons in **Edit touch layout → Extra**.
  Choose a key and label, size, opacity and separate portrait/landscape positions.
  Additional buttons are included in shared profiles.
- Library backups carry profile definitions and assignments. Phone backups carry
  portable per-game definitions. Restore preserves destination profiles when
  names or identities conflict.

releases.name: Anka Native 0.3.0
releases.body:
Anka Native 0.3.0 draws the tree canopies, plants and the arch beside Link's door that 0.2.2 left out, adds a 3D resolution setting, a faster Prepare on the phone and three new languages.
It is still slow: Kokiri Forest runs at about 14 fps on our test phone, and frames are slower than in 0.2.2 where the new content is on screen. The change for the Adreno 840 hang (#5) is untested because we have no Adreno 840.

"Tested on the phone" below means our only test phone: POCO F8 Pro (Adreno 830, 12 GB, Android 16 / HyperOS). "Tests only" means automated tests or a computer, not a phone.

### What is new

- **Mesh-drawn content is now drawn.** Kokiri Forest's tree canopies, grass, ferns, flowers and the arch beside Link's door, and the Deku Tree upper floor's floor that was invisible ([#6](https://github.com/EddizEge/AnkaNative/issues/6)). 0.2.2 skipped these draws on Turnip drivers. Your pack gets the needed shaders through an automatic update (see *After updating*). Tested on the phone with Anka Turnip: no draws skipped in Kokiri Forest and the Deku Tree's upper floor. Not tested on an Adreno 7xx, and not with Qualcomm's own driver.

releases.name: Anka Native 0.2.2
releases.body:
### Security fix

- **The launcher no longer takes control commands from other apps** ([#7](https://github.com/EddizEge/AnkaNative/issues/7)).
  - Before this release, any app on the phone could ask Anka Native's launcher to install or pick a GPU driver, add a game, start Prepare, or export or import a pack. These are commands meant for testing over adb.
  - The app now ignores them and shows a short message, unless you turn on **Settings › ADB control (debug)**. That switch is off by default and asks before it turns on. Turn it on only while you use adb.
  - Starting a game from a frontend works as before.

Everything else is as in [0.2.1](https://github.com/EddizEge/AnkaNative/releases/tag/v0.2.1). The full list of changes is in [CHANGELOG_ANKA_NATIVE.md](https://github.com/EddizEge/AnkaNative/blob/main/CHANGELOG_ANKA_NATIVE.md).

### Files

- `anka-native-0.2.2.apk`: the app (`dev.ankanative.android`), signed with the release key. Certificate SHA-256: `4d7443354f53a0aef11bc4df1a34ff3fc5bd6d748bbeb76fd78c80a6841f3bb0`. It installs over earlier versions and keeps your saves.
- `SHA256SUMS.txt`: checksum of the APK

releases.name: Anka Native 0.2.1
releases.body:
### Fixes

- **Prepare on the phone stopped at the end for Ocarina of Time** ([#3](https://github.com/EddizEge/AnkaNative/issues/3)): "76 of 42346 shaders did not build: no library written".

  The same 76 shaders don't build on a computer either, and the game runs without them. Ocarina of Time's profile was missing the list that tells the phone which shaders those are, so the phone counted them as failures. 0.2.1 adds the list.

  Checked on a computer with the phone's rule: the library is now written, byte for byte the one a computer makes.

  **If your Prepare stopped with this message:** update to 0.2.1, open the game's card and tap **Retry**. The shaders already translated are kept, so it only tries the 76 again and then writes the library.

### New

- **Prepare on a computer on Windows** too, besides Linux and the Mac. Setup: [android/README.md](https://github.com/EddizEge/AnkaNative/blob/main/android/README.md#the-environment).
- **[Discussions](https://github.com/EddizEge/AnkaNative/discussions)** are open. Tell us how it runs on your phone in the [device reports](https://github.com/EddizEge/AnkaNative/discussions/1) thread.

releases.name: Anka Native 0.2.0
releases.body:
**Prepare on the phone (experimental).** The app can now make a game's pack from your dump on the phone itself. You no longer need a computer.

### How

Copy your dump (or `.nup`) to the phone, open **Anka Native**, tap **Add game**, pick the dump and tap **Prepare**. The app does three things in the background, with a notification:

1. It rewrites the game's code.
2. It scans the game's files for shaders.
3. It translates the shaders.

When it is done, the game's card says Ready.

- **Keep the phone on a charger.** For Ocarina of Time, preparing takes about 3 hours and uses the CPU fully.
- If a step fails, the card says why. Its log is in `<title ID>-work/ondevice/logs` next to the dump. Preparing on a computer still works as before.

### What was tested

On a POCO F8 Pro with Ocarina of Time:

- **Code rewrite:** worked, about 3 minutes.
- **Shader scan:** worked, about 35 minutes for the game's 186,583 files. It found 42,346 shaders, as many as on a computer.

releases.name: Anka Native 0.1.1
releases.body:
A fix for 0.1.0: **Prepare on the phone looked done but made nothing to play.**

0.1.0 was built without the on-phone packer. Its Prepare ran a simulated engine: the progress finished, but the pack it made was an empty placeholder with no game code and no shaders, so Play could not start the game.

### What changed

- Without the on-phone packer, the app no longer offers Prepare. Home and the game's card now say to prepare the game on a computer (the README's [Install](https://github.com/EddizEge/AnkaNative#install) steps) and to pick that pack.
- A placeholder pack left by 0.1.0 is no longer shown as ready: the card says "No pack", and Play explains why.

Preparing on the phone itself is being worked on for a later release.

Everything else is as in [0.1.0](https://github.com/EddizEge/AnkaNative/releases/tag/v0.1.0): your own dump is needed, the driver is [Anka Turnip 1.0.0](https://github.com/EddizEge/AnkaTurnip/releases/tag/v1.0.0), and the RAM saver is recommended below 16 GB of RAM. Tested only on a POCO F8 Pro with Ocarina of Time.

releases.name: ARMSX2 2.9.5
releases.body: # ARMSX2 2.9.5 What's new: ## Memory cards **Folder memory cards keep every save.** If your memory card's Type is Folder, every save is now written whole. A save made just before you left the app could come back blank or as the older version, because the card was written to storage between the save's data and its file entry; that can no longer happen. A new save that reuses a deleted save's space keeps its own name instead of reappearing under the deleted one's. A save file the device won't open for writing is still read, where the game showed it as damaged. New saves are created on storage that needs Android's own file access with the IOP thread on, and leaving the app rewrites nothing when nothing on the card changed. done by @bmdhacks

releases.name: ARMSX2 2.9.4
releases.body: # ARMSX2 2.9.4 ## New **Vulkan by default.** New installs start on the Vulkan renderer on every device whose driver reports Vulkan 1.1, and on Auto elsewhere. Existing installs keep the renderer they have. Auto now picks Vulkan on every Mali of the Bifrost G31, G51, G52 and G76 generation and of the Valhall generations (G57 to G78, G310 to G710, G615, G715, Immortalis-G715). done by @bmdhacks **MaliSX2 on every Mali it drives.** The GPU Driver list, the GPU card, first-run setup and the driver notice offer MaliSX2 on the Mali-G31, G51, G52 and G76, G57, G68, G77 and G78, G310, G510, G610 and G710, and G615, G715 and Immortalis-G715. The G31, G51 and G310 to G710 need MaliSX2 0.5.0 or newer. done by @bmdhacks

releases.name: ARMSX2 nightly 20261114 (6d9511e29e)
releases.body:
Automated nightly build for community testing (unsigned).

Every download is named `ARMSX2-nightly-DATE-COMMIT-PLATFORM`, so builds
from different nights stay distinguishable after you have downloaded them.

- macOS arm64: macOS-arm64.tar.xz
- Linux arm64: Linux-arm64-4K-pages.AppImage on most distros, or the 16K one on Asahi Linux and other Apple Silicon kernels (run getconf PAGESIZE if unsure)
- Windows arm64: Windows-arm64.zip
- RetroArch on Linux arm64: Linux-arm64-libretro-core.tar.zst, a 4K-page build
- Bare-display kmsdrm handhelds: Linux-arm64-SDL-handheld.tar.zst, a 4K-page build (Rocknix and Batocera run compositors, so use the Qt AppImage there instead)
- Android: Android-arm64.apk (installs as ARMSX2 Nightly, alongside the stable app)
- iOS: iOS-arm64.ipa, unsigned, sideload it (installs as ARMSX2 Nightly, alongside the stable app)

Coming from an old nightly? Nightlies are now a separate app, ARMSX2 Nightly, next to stable.

- Android: stable cannot install over an old nightly. Back up your saves and memory cards, uninstall the old nightly, then install the stable APK.

Changes since the latest beta release:
- Fixed two UI issues (#843, #846)
- Fixed a bug in the CBM file system implementation (#853)
- Fixed a bug in the drive idle logic (#854)
- Fixed three drive-related VICE tests (#668, #674, #675)

Core and API

* Public API: The API now has as new shape. There are async counterparts (…Async) for state-changing calls, set is now setAsync, there is a new MemoryDebugger API, more getters, and suspend/resume coverage across the API.
* Threading: The command queue and message queue are now std::deque-based. Messages can carry exceptions. AudioPort is thread-safe. Cmd::CALL, TRACK_ON and TRACK_OFF are new.
* Messages: Msg::CONFIG is sent for every option change. ROM_LOADED, RSH_DONE and CONFIG_ERROR are new.
* RetroShell: It has the new architecture from vAmiga, with multiple shells and a single console per shell.
* Workspaces: A screenshot is now saved inside saveWorkspace().
* X-Ray: GPU X-Ray support is added, with a new XRAY_COMPOSITOR option.
* Shared libraries: utlib and rvlib were merged with the versions shared with vAmiga and Silicium.
* Cleanup: Header, include and namespace cleanups, plus removal of orphaned files.

Fixes

* Drive::isIdle() is fixed (#854).

This maintenance release primarily addresses issue #851, which prevented the app from running on the upcoming macOS 27 Golden Gate. It also includes internal code changes required to make the core compatible with the architecture of the upcoming Silicium emulator.
Removing beta status, as no significant bugs have been reported for some time.

## Refactoring

This beta release introduces substantial changes to the underlying code base. As part of the development of the RetroVault app, a new **RetroVault** library has been created. This library is now responsible for managing:

- File systems  
- Devices  
- All supported image formats  

RetroVault is designed as a standalone library and is also used in the latest version of vAmiga for the same purpose.

In addition, the new **utlib** library has been introduced. All utility functions previously embedded in vAmiga and VirtualC64 have been refactored into this more powerful shared library. This makes it easier for me to share common functionality among the different emulators. 

## Enhancements

- The disassembler now supports symbol files (#837)

## Bug Fixes

- Fixed a crash in the file system importer when importing excessively large folders (#841)  
- Fixed a bug in the VIC inspector that prevented selecting individual sprites in Tahoe (#840)

# 0.60.0 is out 🎉

This release is special for me. I build emuze with web technologies because that’s where I have the most experience, and I’m really proud of what I’ve achieved over the years. I’ve always wanted to help out in this wonderful emulation community, but aside from testing, I couldn’t do much to help with the emulators I love because I struggled with C++ code, which most emulators are written in. But sometimes you feel forced to try and try again. Since v0.59.0, I’ve successfully added a [change to RMG](https://github.com/Rosalie241/RMG/pull/518) to use the SDL GUID to identify a gamepad more reliably, and I forked Mednafen with [mednafen-sdl3](https://github.com/bmsuseluda/mednafen-sdl3) to greatly expand gamepad support. Those changes are just baby steps in the grand scheme of things, but they felt great, and I hope I can build on them in the future.

# 0.59.2 is out 🎉

This release is mostly preparation work to greatly reduce the file size of the AppImage with release 0.60.0.
Besides this fuse2 is not necessary anymore and Metainfos for AppImage Managers e.g. AM are included.

Please let me know what you think of it in the [emuze discord](https://discord.gg/tCzK7kc6Y4).

## 💥 Features
- added AppImage Metainfos
- AppImage works without fuse2
- Preparation work to greatly reduce the file size of the AppImage with release 0.60.0

# 0.59.0 is out 🎉

As you might now i love the simplicity of console gaming. You start the game and it just works. With emulation more often then not you have to provide more then just the game. You need things like a BIOS file, firmware or key files. I wanted to assist with this for a long time. With this release you can choose a folder where you can put your BIOS files and emuze will pick them up and configure the Emulators. Of course emuze will tell you if a required file is missing. On top of this emuze comes bundled with open source BIOS implementations for PlayStation, Game Boy Advance and NEO GEO. Of course you can use official BIOS files instead if you need by putting them in the BIOS folder. Sadly i was not able to achieve the same result for more complicated systems like PlayStation 3, WiiU and Switch. These systems require a installation of a firmware. I will try to tackle these in a future release.

Besides this i bundled and pre configured ScummVM and DOSBox Pure Unleashed.
Therefore the day is finally here: All 35 supported systems are pre configured and bundled now 🥳

# 0.58.0 is out 🎉

As one of the few nerdy kids in a small sleepy town in a country where arcade gaming was classified as gambling i could see lightgun games in magazines only. I had an NES and Captain N with his Zapper was sooo awesome to me. But when the time came that i could buy one with my own money the rise of flat panels began and with it the death of CRT TVs and Lightguns altogether. It was just a thing of the past, sadly.
But surprisingly the genre came back with the Wii and PS3 and there Pointer devices. Some years later camera based Lightguns came to the market and finally Lightgun gaming with the same and even higher precision is possible on flat panels.

# Lichii-Enhanced v1.0.0: first public release

Lichii-Enhanced is a fork of [Lichii](https://github.com/zortos293/Lichii) focused on usability: easier setup, built-in upscaling, non-destructive modding and more reliable online play. This is the first public release.

> **Platform:** Windows 10/11 x64 only. Distributed as a `.zip` archive. Other platforms are not available yet.

## Highlights

### 🖼️ Built-in upscalers
Upscaling is now part of the renderer; no external injectors or wrappers are needed.

- New post-process stage at the end of the Vulkan frame (compute shaders), running after game rendering and before swapchain presentation
- Filters: Nearest, Bilinear, Bicubic, FSR 1.0 (EASU + RCAS), SGSR
- Configurable render scale and sharpness (RCAS strength)
- Per-game profiles stored in `config/custom/<title-id>.ini`
- Optional anti-aliasing pass before upscaling

releases.name: NSP Box 4.0.0 — Meet NUP
releases.body:
# NSP Box 4.0.0 — Meet NUP

Smaller archives, flexible packaging, and more control over your game collection. Version 4.0 introduces **NUP Tools**, alongside the existing NSP builder.

### Package more. Store less.

- **Create compressed NUP archives** from extracted game folders, with base games, updates and DLC together in one file.
- **Choose your balance:** Fast for quicker compression, Balanced for everyday use, or Smaller for stronger compression. Incompressible files are stored raw automatically.
- **Keep what you need:** select Base, Updates and DLC independently. Choices appear after inspection, only for content present in your source. Latest-snapshot mode merges the newest selected update with the selected base, retains required base-only files, and leaves superseded versions behind. Turn it off to keep separate base/update records.
- **Avoid duplicate storage:** identical file contents can share the same space inside an archive.
- **Stay compatible:** leave files larger than 256 MiB uncompressed to reduce temporary decompression work in supported emulators.

### Convert, extract and check

- **NSP → NUP:** compress plaintext NSPs created by NSP Box.

releases.name: Version 5.10.1
releases.body:
Changes:

* `install`, `push`: better handling for registry rate limits (HTTP 429) by honoring `Retry-After`, show detailed error when rate limit occurs while using a shared Docker Hub frontend (proxy) instead of raw `Network error: HTTP Error 429`.

Notice for users: this does not resolve issue with rate limits imposed by Docker Hub registry. Such issue just can't be resolved at proot-distro side because restriction applies to client IP address, which in case of NAT (CG-NAT) or proxy may be shared between large amount of devices.

Don't submit bug reports if encounter HTTP 429!

Workaround:

1. Create Docker Hub account.
2. Use `export PD_DOCKER_AUTH="username:password"` or `export PD_DOCKER_AUTH="username:personal-access-token"`, the personal access token must be created through account settings with permissions at least for read-only access.

releases.name: Version 5.10.0
releases.body:
Changes:

- refs: Image names are now checked using Docker's rules. Malformed names are refused with a clear message.
- install: Added support for images pinned by digest, e.g. `ubuntu@sha256:...`. The download is verified against the digest. A pinned image can be reinstalled from the cache without network.
- build, push: A digest is refused in `build -t` and `push`.
- install: Fixed intact image layers sometimes refused with "does not match its digest".
- http: Redirects can no longer move a download from HTTPS to plain HTTP. `--allow-insecure` lifts this.
- registry: `--allow-insecure` no longer applies to Docker Hub. It is always verified.
- http: Network requests give up after 2 minutes of silence instead of hanging forever.
- http: Invalid URLs and registry addresses now show an error message instead of a traceback.
- build, login: Bytes that are not valid UTF-8 in arguments, build args or image environment no longer cause a traceback.
- list, remove: `--image` no longer prints control characters from cache entries as they are.
- sync, copy: Files that change during the transfer are handled correctly. No more missed updates or wrong permissions.

releases.name: Version 5.9.0
releases.body:
Changes:

- `login`, `run`: export variables `PD_CONTAINER=<name>`, `PD_IMAGE=<image-ref>`, `PD_IMAGE_ID=<sha256-digest>` and `container=proot-distro` in sessions. Build gets same except `PD_CONTAINER`.
- `pull`: detect whether image config or manifest is shorter than `Content-Length`.
- `build` (ADD, COPY): placing directory over an existing regular file is now a refusal instead of a silent tree/layer mismatch.
- `build` (... --chmod): validate value as an octal between 0 and 07777.
- `build`: Dockerfile is read with 16 MiB limit.
- `push`: send the Bearer token on the upload PUT only when the Location URL belongs to the registry itself.
- Registry credentials are only sent to the origin they were addressed to.
- Do not carry Authorization header if host redirects from HTTPS to HTTP.
- A token endpoint realm must be `https://` (`http://` allowed under --allow-insecure). `file://`, `ftp://` and `data:` realms are refused.
- Environment strings from image config are validated before exec (no NUL, encodable, under 128 KiB).
- The `profile.d` snippet is written for every session of a normal-type container, not only default-mode Termux logins.

releases.body:
# Next release will be WatermelonDS!

This release is focused on RetroAchievements stability, Hardcore achievement reliability, leaderboards, and new offline achievement provider options.

This will also be the last release using the current **melonDualDS** name.

The next release will introduce a new interface, a new icon, and a new experimental Vulkan feature called **FastPath**. FastPath is designed to significantly improve performance at high internal resolutions, even up to 8x in some cases.

However, FastPath will be experimental. If you want the most stable and accurate experience, closer to real Nintendo DS behavior, it is recommended to keep FastPath disabled when it becomes available. It will be especially useful for devices with slightly weaker chipsets, or for users who want to get the most performance and battery efficiency possible.

For RC5, the focus is not Vulkan, UI changes, or general emulator fixes. This release is mainly about making RetroAchievements more stable, more reliable, and more flexible.

RC4 focuses on fixing the remaining major Vulkan renderer issues, stabilizing RetroAchievements, improving DSi / DSiWare support, and adding custom Adreno Vulkan driver support through AdrenoTools.

Primera versión de LibertyDroid: port nativo y no oficial de GTA IV y Episodes from Liberty City (Xbox 360) a Android, con launcher propio.

**Descarga:** `LibertyDroid-1.0.0.apk`, en los archivos de esta versión. - Renderizador nativo Vulkan para Mali y Adreno, con Turnip cuando el driver del móvil no basta.
- Sombras estabilizadas al conducir, luces locales en GTA IV y fuentes vectoriales.

## Limitaciones

- Solo admite las ISO de la versión USA, sin actualizaciones.
- El APK es una compilación de depuración, firmada con una clave de desarrollo.

releases.name: PvZ: Replanted Android v0.1.4-beta
releases.body:
Fifth beta of the Android port of the PS5 version of **Plants vs. Zombies: Replanted** (AnyPS5 + Box64 + Turnip). Installs over earlier betas, game data and settings are kept.

> ⚠️ The game is not included — you need your own legally obtained, **decrypted** PS5 dump (PPSA29802).

### Fixes
- **A second player (2P) joined when pausing.** The game opens a second ("special") pad port, and it got the same input as the real pad, so Options there counted as player 2 joining. Only the standard port is the pad now.
- **Touches beside the on-screen buttons acted as a mouse**, a second input device for the game. The touch controls are the only player-1 input now (a real mouse or keyboard still works once used).

### Performance and heat
- **Built-in Turnip updated to Mesa 26.3** with our patch for importing the game's memory directly (no per-draw copies). If you picked another driver in *Settings → GPU driver*, switch back to **Built-in**: drivers without this import copy memory on every draw.

releases.name: PvZ: Replanted Android v0.1.3-beta
releases.body:
Fourth beta of the Android port of the PS5 version of **Plants vs. Zombies: Replanted** (AnyPS5 + Box64 + Turnip). Installs over earlier betas, game data and settings are kept.

> ⚠️ The game is not included — you need your own legally obtained, **decrypted** PS5 dump (PPSA29802).

### Fixes
- **Missing graphics and crashes on scene changes** (starting a level, the money bag at the end of a level): results the GPU writes back into game memory were silently skipped on pages the driver's write tracking had protected, so the game read stale or zero data. Menu elements that never showed up before (e.g. the Co-op / Vs. tombstone) are back.
- "storage texture has no committed guest pages" crash.

### Performance and heat
- Draw recipes now work for the menu (repeated draws reuse their recorded setup).
- Box64 spin-waits sleep (`PAUSE=3`, WFE) instead of spinning: less CPU load for the same frame rate.
- The driver's two threads wake each other only when one actually waits.

### Requirements
- Adreno (Snapdragon) GPU only; Android 11+ recommended. Tested on Snapdragon 8 Elite.

> ⚠️ The game is not included — you need your own legally obtained, **decrypted** PS5 dump (PPSA29802, the folder with `eboot.bin`).

### What's new
- **⚙ Settings tab**: graphics, controls, language and help in one place.
- **Touch layout editor**: drag the controls, resize one or all, hide or add buttons (right stick, R3), opacity, reset.
- **Profile name input**: the game's text input now opens the phone's keyboard (the name used to be a fixed default).
- **Resolution**: Auto (screen proportions, no taller than the game's 1080p frame), Screen, 720p; image on a wide screen: Fit / Fill / Stretch.
- **Logs for a bug report (zip)** at the bottom of Settings: game log, logcat, device info and the reason of the last crash, no root needed. Attach it to an [issue](https://github.com/SFEZSergey/ReplantedAndroid/issues/new/choose).

> ⚠️ The game is not included in the APK — you need your own **decrypted** PS5 dump (PPSA29802, the folder with `eboot.bin`).

### What's new
- **Launcher in English** by default (follows the phone language; English / Russian can be chosen in "Language").
- **GPU driver** setting: the built-in Turnip, the phone's system Vulkan driver, or your own driver package (an adrenotools `.zip` with `meta.json`, as used by Yuzu/Eden/Winlator). If the chosen driver fails to load, the built-in Turnip is used.
- **Game language** setting: the languages the game is translated into (read from the dump: English, French, German, Spanish, Japanese, Portuguese (Brazil)), or "System" — the phone's language if the game has it, English otherwise. The game itself has no Russian translation.
- The APK is now signed with **v2 + v3** signatures, so it installs on MIUI / older Android versions that rejected v0.1.0 ("There was a problem parsing the package").

### Requirements
- Android 8.0+, arm64.

releases.name: PvZ: Replanted Android v0.1.0-beta
releases.body:
First public beta of the Android port of the PS5 version of **Plants vs. Zombies: Replanted**.

> ⚠️ The game is not included in the APK — you need your own **decrypted** PS5 dump (PPSA29802, the folder with `eboot.bin`).

### Requirements
- Android 8.0+, arm64.
- **An Adreno (Snapdragon) GPU.** The bundled Turnip driver only works on Adreno.
- 8 GB of RAM and a fast CPU recommended (tested on Snapdragon 8 Elite).

### How to run
1. Install the APK.
2. "Папка дампа" (dump folder) → pick the dump folder (the one with `eboot.bin`).
3. "Импорт и запуск" (import and run) — the first time, copying and preparation take a few minutes; afterwards the button is "Играть" (play).

### What works (Snapdragon 8 Elite)
- Intros and title screen — 60 FPS; main menu — ~37–43 FPS; levels — ~48–53 FPS.
- Sound, gamepad, touch controls (a virtual gamepad; the eye button hides it).
- FPS limit 60/45/30 and "GPU turbo" in the launcher.

### Known issues
- Strong heating during long sessions → the phone lowers its clocks and FPS drops. For long sessions use the **45 FPS** limit.
- The menu is slower than levels (the driver is still single-threaded).
- A rare crash while a level loads — just restart.

### Fixes
- **A second player (2P) joined when pausing.** The game opens a second ("special") pad port, and it got the same input as the real pad, so Options there counted as player 2 joining. Only the standard port is the pad now.
- **Touches beside the on-screen buttons acted as a mouse**, a second input device for the game. The touch controls are the only player-1 input now (a real mouse or keyboard still works once used).

- **Built-in Turnip updated to Mesa 26.3** with our patch for importing the game's memory directly (no per-draw copies). If you picked another driver in *Settings → GPU driver*, switch back to **Built-in**: drivers without this import copy memory on every draw.

releases.name: NDS Station per Android 2.2.0
releases.body:
## Novità per gli amministratori

- **Cambia nome utente**: dalla lista utenti. L'utente viene disconnesso e accede di nuovo con il nuovo nome; salvataggi, console e amici restano invariati.
- **Salvataggi di un giocatore**: per ogni gioco puoi scaricare il salvataggio del giocatore oppure sostituirlo (o crearlo) con un file .sav, anche esportato da DeSmuME o da un altro emulatore. Prima di caricare viene chiesta conferma, con un avviso se le dimensioni non corrispondono al salvataggio attuale. La versione sostituita resta nella cronologia del server, e se il giocatore stava giocando su quella vecchia all'uscita gli viene chiesto quale tenere.

## Altre modifiche

- I dati locali (ROM in cache, copie dei salvataggi, stati salvati) sono legati all'account e non più al nome utente: dopo un cambio di nome restano al loro posto. Alla prima apertura vengono spostati automaticamente.

## Requisiti

Server [nds-server-emulator-fastapi](https://github.com/federico-castellani/nds-server-emulator-fastapi) aggiornato (commit `7d2701c`). Con un server precedente l'app funziona, ma le nuove funzioni di amministrazione non sono disponibili.

releases.body:
## Novità

- **Aggiornamenti dall'app**: NDS Station controlla da solo se c'è una nuova versione (all'avvio, oppure da Impostazioni → Aggiornamenti), scarica l'APK, lo verifica e lo installa. Android chiede conferma; partite, salvataggi e impostazioni restano. La prima volta va consentita l'installazione di app da NDS Station.
- **Audio in avanti veloce**: il suono non si spegne più. Resta al tono originale (voci ed effetti naturali, la musica avanza a salti) a volume un po' più basso. In Impostazioni → Audio puoi scegliere anche "Accelerato" o "Muto".

Scarica `NDSStation-2.1.0.apk` sul telefono e aprilo. Si installa sopra la versione precedente senza perdere i dati. Dalle prossime versioni l'aggiornamento avverrà dall'app.

releases.name: NDS Station per Android 2.0.1
releases.body:
Prima versione per Android di NDS Station, con le stesse funzioni del client Windows 2.0.1.

## Funzioni

- Libreria del server con ricerca; ROM scaricate e tenute in cache.
- Emulatore melonDS con tasti virtuali su schermo, touch sullo schermo inferiore, controller fisici, pausa, avanti veloce e stati salvati.
- Salvataggi sincronizzati con il server; se un altro dispositivo ha salvato un progresso più recente, all'uscita scegli se sovrascriverlo.
- Stessa identità di console di PC e telefono: la lista amici Nintendo WFC resta valida.
- Lotte e scambi online tramite Nintendo WFC, anche tra giocatori sulla stessa rete di casa.
- Pannello di amministrazione.

## Requisiti

- Android 8.0 o superiore (arm64 o x86_64).
- Server [nds-server-emulator-fastapi](https://github.com/federico-castellani/nds-server-emulator-fastapi) aggiornato.

## Installazione

Scarica `NDSStation-2.0.1.apk` sul telefono e aprilo (va consentita l'installazione da origini sconosciute). L'APK è firmato con una chiave di sviluppo: per aggiornarlo in futuro usa sempre gli APK di queste release.

releases.name: v1.0.0 — Winlator 适配包
releases.body:
在 Android（[Winlator](https://github.com/brunodev85/winlator)）与 ARM Linux（Wine + Box64）上运行 DFLegacy 60 版单机端的适配包。

## 包含

| 文件 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| `d3d8.dll` | d3d8to9 v1.15.1 预编译包装层（x86，124 KB） |
| `LICENSE.md` | d3d8to9 的 BSD-3-Clause 许可 |
| `使用说明.md` | 完整部署说明 |
| `放置说明.txt` | 快速上手 |

## 解决什么问题

客户端是 2008 年的 32 位程序，**只认 Direct3D 8**。Android 上的 DXVK 只支持 D3D9 及以上，直接跑会黑屏或崩溃。

这个 `d3d8.dll` 把 D3D8 调用逐条翻译成 D3D9：

```
DNF.exe → d3d8.dll → D3D9 → DXVK → Vulkan → Adreno / Mali
```

绕开 Wine 自带的 `wined3d → OpenGL` 路径，走 Vulkan 后端。

## 用法

1. 解压，把 `d3d8.dll` 复制到 `DNF.exe` 同级目录
2. Winlator 容器里设 `WINEDLLOVERRIDES=d3d8=n,b`
3. Box86 / Box64 都打开，DXVK 选 2.x
4. 运行 `DNF.exe`

**Windows 本机不要放这个文件** —— 原生 D3D8 路径工作正常，放进去反而改变渲染路径。

## 前提

服务端需要是 x86 构建（NativeAOT `-r win-x86`），否则在纯 32 位环境里加载不了。相关改动见 [DFLegacyAot](https://github.com/Yoshino-Loli/DFLegacyAot)。

## 未验证项

- `ijl15.dll` 的 WIC JPEG 解码在 Wine 下的表现
- Job Object 的退出联动在 Wine 下的可靠性（失败时手动结束服务端即可）

真机帧数需自行测试，骁龙 8 系预期 25~40 fps。

## 不包含

游戏客户端本体与任何受版权保护的资源。`DNF.exe`、`Script.pvf`、`ImagePacks2` 等权利归原权利人所有。
